services.name: Website Development
services.summary: Thoughtful websites shaped around your business, your audience and the work you need the site to do.
services.who: Businesses ready for a clearer, more capable digital presence.
services.helps: Bring your story, services and next step together in one considered experience.
services.deliver: Planning, page structure, responsive design, development and launch support, scoped to the project.
faqs: What does website development include?
It can include discovery, site structure, visual design, development, content guidance, testing and launch. The exact scope is agreed around your goals.
How long does a website take to build?
Timing depends on the number of pages, features, content readiness and review cycles. VRAELIX confirms a realistic timeline after understanding the brief.
Can an existing website be improved?
Yes. A project can focus on redesign, accessibility, performance, content structure or a specific set of improvements.

services.name: Business & Corporate Websites
services.summary: A structured business website that helps people understand what you do, who you help and how to take the next step.
services.who: Small and growing businesses, professional teams and organisations.
services.helps: Make essential information easier to find and your offer easier to understand.
services.deliver: A clear page system for your story, services, expertise and enquiries, shaped to your audience.
faqs: What makes a business website effective?
It answers the visitor’s key questions quickly: what the business does, who it helps, why the offer matters and what to do next.
Can a corporate site grow over time?
Yes. A well-planned structure can make room for new services, content and capabilities without forcing a complete rebuild.
Do you write the website content?
Content support can be included in the agreed scope. We begin by clarifying the message and the information each page needs.

services.name: E-commerce Solutions
services.summary: An online store planned around your products, customer journey and day-to-day operations.
services.who: Businesses that want to sell products or services online.
services.helps: Connect product discovery, useful information and a straightforward route to purchase.
services.deliver: Store structure, product and collection layouts, responsive storefront design and the agreed platform setup.
faqs: Can you build a new online store?
Yes. The right approach depends on your catalogue, operations and preferred platform. We scope those needs before recommending a build.
Can you improve an existing store?
Yes. Work can focus on navigation, product pages, mobile usability or specific parts of the shopping journey.
Do you guarantee sales?
No. Sales depend on many factors beyond a website. VRAELIX focuses on a considered storefront and a clear customer experience.

services.name: Landing Pages & Conversion Experiences
services.summary: Focused digital pages that give a campaign, offer or product a clear place to land.
services.who: Teams promoting a specific offer, launch, event or campaign.
services.helps: Keep attention on the message and the action that matters for that visitor.
services.deliver: A concise page structure, responsive layout, message hierarchy and enquiry or action flow.
faqs: When should I use a landing page?
A focused landing page can help when a campaign has one audience, one message and one main action.
Can a landing page connect to an existing campaign?
Yes. It can be planned to work with your current website, campaign assets and measurement setup.
Is conversion guaranteed?
No. The page can make the offer and action clearer, while campaign fit, audience and timing also influence results.

services.name: SEO & Performance
services.summary: Technical and on-page improvements that make a website easier to find, understand and use.
services.who: Businesses improving an existing website or preparing a new one for discovery.
services.helps: Address structural, content and speed issues that can create friction for people and search systems.
services.deliver: A scoped review of technical foundations, semantics, internal links, image handling, accessibility and page performance.
faqs: What does SEO work cover?
SEO can include crawl and index basics, page titles and descriptions, heading structure, internal links, image alternatives and useful content aligned to search intent.
Can SEO guarantee a first-page ranking?
No. Search visibility depends on competition, authority, content quality, technical health and factors outside any single provider’s control.
Do you work on website speed?
Yes. Performance can be reviewed as part of a new build or a separate improvement scope.

services.name: Website Maintenance & Optimization
services.summary: Practical upkeep and improvements to keep a website current, usable and aligned with changing needs.
services.who: Teams that need ongoing technical care or a steady stream of considered updates.
services.helps: Reduce avoidable friction as content, tools and business needs change.
services.deliver: A maintenance or optimization scope agreed around your platform, priorities and preferred cadence.
faqs: What can website maintenance include?
Depending on the platform and scope, it can include content updates, routine checks, software updates, backups and small improvements.
Can you maintain a website built by another team?
Often, yes. We first review the site, its platform and access needs to understand what support is appropriate.
Is maintenance a fixed package?
The scope can be shaped around the site and the support you need. Details are agreed before work begins.

services.name: Business Automation
services.summary: Explore practical ways to connect repetitive tasks and information flows across your business.
services.who: Teams looking to reduce manual steps or improve how information moves between tools.
services.helps: Map a repeatable process, identify friction and scope a suitable automation approach.
services.deliver: A discovery-led engagement to understand the workflow, tools, constraints and a sensible next step.
faqs: What kinds of processes can be automated?
Common candidates are repeatable, rules-based tasks such as routing enquiries, updating records or moving information between tools. Each workflow needs to be assessed.
Do you already offer a specific automation product?
No single product is assumed. The tools and approach are chosen around the process and your existing systems.
Can automation remove all manual work?
No. Automation can support defined steps, but people still need visibility, exception handling and appropriate control.

services.name: Custom Digital Solutions
services.summary: A considered path for digital requirements that do not fit neatly into a standard website or tool.
services.who: Businesses with a specific product, system or customer-experience need.
services.helps: Turn an early idea or operational challenge into a clear, scoped digital direction.
services.deliver: Initial problem framing and a project approach based on the people, systems and constraints involved.
faqs: What counts as a custom digital solution?
It could be a tailored web experience, a business tool or a connection between existing systems. The right shape depends on the need.
Can you scope an idea that is still early?
Yes. A first conversation can clarify the intended users, problem, constraints and what a useful first version might include.
Do you build every type of software?
No. VRAELIX assesses fit and scope before recommending a project, and does not claim capability beyond what can be delivered responsibly.

faqs: What does VRAELIX do?

VRAELIX builds thoughtful digital experiences and business systems around real business needs. Current services include websites, e-commerce, SEO and performance, maintenance, automation and custom digital solutions.
How do I choose the right service?
Start with the change you need. VRAELIX can help clarify the problem, audience and desired outcome before recommending a scope.
Do you work with businesses of different sizes?
VRAELIX can discuss projects with businesses and teams at different stages. Fit depends on the need, scope and delivery approach.
insights: What should a business website make clear?

A visitor should be able to understand the offer, recognise whether it fits and find a next step. Start by listing the questions customers ask before they contact you. Then make sure the most useful answers appear where people expect them.
When is business automation worth exploring?

Look for work that repeats, follows clear rules and moves information between known steps. Map the process first, including exceptions and handoffs. Automation is a good candidate when it makes that flow simpler without removing necessary judgement.
How do you scope a digital project with confidence?

Describe the person who needs the change, the friction they face and what would be different if the work succeeds. A clear problem statement gives the team a way to prioritise features, estimate effort and decide what can wait.

privacy: In the reviewed Staging setup, the Request a Quote form sends submitted enquiry details to a Supabase Edge Function, which validates the request and stores accepted enquiries in the Supabase database. Cloudflare Turnstile verifies the form challenge, and Upstash Redis supports rate limiting. The Staging preview also uses browser storage for the privacy preference and a temporary confirmation copy. Production processing has not been verified.

The submitted record has 11 named fields: full name, email, company or business name (optional), requested service, phone number, preferred contact method, project description, budget (optional), timeline (optional), a site-set source label and a server-generated submission timestamp. Please include only information needed to respond to your enquiry.

After the form receives a successful response, the browser keeps a temporary sessionStorage copy of the submitted brief so the Thank You page can show the confirmation details. This copy remains in the current tab session and is not sent again from storage. A separate essential-only localStorage preference remembers your privacy choice and contains no personal information.

In the reviewed Staging implementation, Supabase runs the enquiry function and stores accepted enquiries. Cloudflare Turnstile provides a challenge token that the function verifies. For rate limiting, the function sends Upstash Redis a keyed hash derived from the configured client-IP header, not the enquiry fields or the raw IP value. Provider-side processing is governed by each provider’s own terms. Production processing has not been verified.

VRAELIX keeps enquiries for up to 12 months. If an enquiry becomes a project, related records are kept as long as needed for the work and business records. Automatic deletion and backup retention settings have not been verified. You can ask to access or delete an enquiry through the contact page or at vraelix29@gmail.com; VRAELIX aims to respond within 30 days.
